rows: T-001: new business object 'ContainerType' proposed for bronze.container_track.container_types. 5-row ISO size/type code list used by containers.TYPE_CD. It classifies containers; it is not the Container object. No classification object exi

T-001: new business object 'CarrierContact' proposed for bronze.container_track.carrier_contacts. Dispatch contacts of each carrier. Needed by operations to call the carrier. Personal data; no object in business.yaml for carrier contacts.

T-006: Brief says grain key CNTR_NO + SHPMT_ID + LEG_NO; bronze shows SHPMT_ID + LEG_NO is the minimal unique key (one container per shipment in this data). Confirm with the client which one defines a leg.
